'''2001 Dutch National Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG national championship held in Eusebiuskerk, Arnhem, Netherlands on 13 May 2001. [[Johan van der Meer]] won it. It is known from Johan van der Meer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2321">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-18-eusebiuskerk-arnhem-13-5-2001d2321/ eusebiuskerk-arnhem-13-5-2001], DeckTech (Johan "Johan" van der Meer, 18 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-18-eusebiuskerk-arnhem-13-5-2001d2321/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Eusebiuskerk, Arnhem, Netherlands
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Johan van der Meer]]
